newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy sees approvals for Atacama in 3 months.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy sees approvals for Atacama in 3 months.

text.p: CMS Energy officials said Wednesday they expected to secure approvals for the Atacama natural gas pipeline-power project within the next month from Chile and within three months from Argentina.

The project, which involves piping natural gas from Argentina to northern Chile and building a 700 megawatt power plant in Chile's copper mining region, could eventually be worth more than $1.0 billion.

"We expect the concession approval by the Chilean government within the next 30 days, and we expect the concession approval by the Argentine government within the next 60 to 90 days," CMS Energy president Victor Fryling said at a press briefing.
He said he expected to issue a notice to proceed with the power plant within the next week to 10 days.
The company earlier let out contracts to build the 925 kilometer pipeline, and has already signed contracts or has options for gas supplies to the power plant.
